description: Moves the non-empty pointers in a table of record pointers to the front, then sorts the table in place by a byte at a fixed offset in each record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:009C
name: sort_entry_table_by_byte
description: Sorts a table of record pointers in place by a byte at a fixed offset in each record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:00CE
name: allocate_entry_with_subrecords
description: Allocates a record through the exec library and stores its pointer in a slot. It copies input parameters into fixed offsets, rounds a size up to a multiple of sixteen when a flag bit is set, and fills a chain of sub-records with computed positions. It returns a negative code when the allocation fails.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:0242
name: allocate_and_mask_plane_buffer
description: Allocates a buffer for an entry slot through the exec library, rejecting an out-of-range slot index and rounding the size up to a multiple of sixteen when needed. When a flag bit is set it copies the existing data into a second buffer, ORs a mask into each row and copies the result back.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:0314
name: blit_masked_list_with_modes
description: Takes blitter ownership and programs a masked blit whose first-word mask comes from the low bits of a byte. It walks a list of pointers, running a transfer for each entry and switching the control setting between a copy mode and two other modes by a status value. It then releases the blitter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:03AC
name: run_with_temporary_mode_flag
description: Saves two fields of a record, sets one of them to a flag value and a shared global to a fixed mode value, calls another routine, then restores the global and both fields.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:04BC
name: build_index_lookup_table
description: Scans a list of three-byte records and, for each record whose first byte is a fixed marker, writes its position into a lookup table and counts it in a shared byte. It resets that byte at the end.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:04FC
name: blit_tile_cells_from_index
description: Walks cells of a tile grid numbered in rows of thirteen, converting each cell index into a screen position and blitting a small tile at each position with a fixed number of repeats.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:0620
name: update_active_entries_and_dma
description: Sets a DMA control word with its enable bit at the start. It walks up to fourteen entry pointers and, for each active entry, sets per-field bits for the current buffer side, computes a position from the entry's fields and calls other routines to update it. It clears the control word and the counter at the end.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:0838
name: build_threshold_bit_pattern
description: Clears a table of words and then steps a fixed-point accumulator once per row. Each time it passes a threshold of one thousand it sets a bit in a bitmap and counts it, so the bitmap spreads the set bits evenly across the rows.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:084C
name: build_threshold_bit_pattern
description: Clears a table of words and then steps a fixed-point accumulator once per row. Each time it passes a threshold of one thousand it sets a bit in a bitmap and counts it, so the bitmap spreads the set bits evenly across the rows.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:0860
name: build_bit_pattern_and_dma
description: Builds a threshold-spaced bitmap from an accumulator in the same way as its neighbours, then calls several other routines and writes a DMA control word with the enable bit set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:0A36
name: copy_rows_with_stride_table
description: Copies bytes row by row from a source buffer into a destination, reading the source backwards and using stride tables to find each row. It sets a DMA control word with the enable bit at the end and calls two other routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:0CDA
name: blit_destination_rows_from_list
description: Takes blitter ownership, then walks a pointer list, writing each destination address and starting a transfer with a control setting that uses only the destination channel. It releases the blitter when the list ends.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:0D2C
name: blit_clipped_sprite_row
description: Clips a horizontal span to a fixed window range, then programs the blitter with masks and modulos to draw it. It picks one of three control modes from a state flag, and waits for the transfer to finish before releasing the blitter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:0E44
name: blit_shifted_masked_block
description: Programs a blitter copy for a block that starts at an arbitrary bit offset. It derives first-word and last-word masks and a barrel shift from the low bits of the data register, and sets the source and destination modulos from the block width. It runs the transfer row by row through library calls.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:0F16
name: stub_empty_return
description: Tests a word argument and returns in both branches, so the body does nothing. It is a stub with no recoverable behaviour.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:0F3C
name: setup_bitmap_block_from_arrays
description: Reads a size and a base value from two input arrays, takes and releases the blitter through library calls, and stores fixed window and mode words with the computed widths into a control block. It then calls another routine to fill the rows.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:0FA4
name: setup_bitmap_block_alt_arrays
description: Does the same control-block setup as its neighbour, reading the size and base from the other pair of input arrays, and then calls another routine to fill the rows.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:100E
name: wait_flag_then_call
description: Waits while a flag global is set, repeatedly calling another routine, then makes one final call.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:102E
name: call_twice_if_zero
description: Calls a check routine and, when its result is zero, makes two more calls.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:1050
name: walk_record_table_positions
description: Clears a counter, then walks a table of record pointers, writing a position from an input array into each record and advancing through the table. It then scans a further table and calls a library routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:10E2
name: advance_record_animation_frames
description: Walks up to fifteen record pointers. For each active record whose two frame bytes differ, it counts down a delay and, when the delay expires, advances or resets the frame using flag bits and updates its state.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:118E
name: deactivate_record_when_done
description: Clears a record's active bit once its countdown reaches zero, unless its flag byte is the stop marker. When it does so it also clears the shared handler pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:12F4
name: store_record_channel_values
description: Reads a byte from the record's status, clamps two input bytes against a maximum stored in the record, and stores one of them into the record's fields, choosing by mask bits. Otherwise it stores a long value into a field.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:1378
name: dispatch_glyph_draw_by_code
description: Dispatches on a character code and runs a counted draw or delay loop for each class of code, then returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:13F8
name: wait_until_counter_in_range
description: Repeatedly calls another routine until a counter falls outside a fixed range, then returns the stored value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:14A8
name: setup_three_row_blit_block
description: Takes blitter ownership, sets fixed masks, row modulos of thirty-eight and a control word, then loops three times. Each pass computes row pointers from two input arrays and starts a transfer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:1500
name: setup_blit_rows_with_width
description: Takes blitter ownership and sets fixed masks and a control word. It loops three times, computing row pointers from two input arrays and starting a transfer with a fixed row width of four hundred and four.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:3:1568
name: set_mode_around_call
description: Sets a shared mode value, makes one call, then sets the mode to a second fixed value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0000
name: clamp_scaled_value_into_struct
description: Scales a shared value by two byte factors taken from a structure, shifting right by seven bits after each step. It clamps the result to a maximum of sixty-four and stores it back into the structure.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0038
name: choose_record_slot_with_fallback
description: Chooses one of a small set of fixed-size records by index, trying the candidate and its partner with the low bits flipped. It falls back to another lookup when a record is marked busy or its threshold is not met.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:011C
name: store_bit_two_flag
description: Stores a register byte masked with the value two through an address register pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:012A
name: stub_empty_return
description: The decompiled body is only a return, so the routine has no recoverable behaviour in the evidence.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0166
name: compute_fixed_point_position
description: Computes a fixed-point position from several record fields, adding a divide-by-twenty-four term and a stored offset. It clamps the result into a fixed range by walking a linked list and uses a 32-bit fixed-point multiply routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0208
name: store_value_when_delta_large
description: Compares a 32-bit input with a stored value and, when the difference passes a fixed threshold, calls another routine and stores its result in a word field.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0228
name: call_when_nonzero_input
description: Calls another routine only when the input word is nonzero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0258
name: stub_empty_return
description: The decompiled body is only a return, so the routine has no recoverable behaviour in the evidence.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:025C
name: advance_record_state_machine
description: Adds the input amount to a field and dispatches on a state byte. In state four it returns unless a flag is set, in state one it makes a call, and in state six it loads the next data pointer and moves to the next state.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0288
name: advance_record_state_machine
description: Adds the input amount to a field and dispatches on a state byte. In state four it returns unless a flag is set, in state one it makes a call, and in state six it loads the next data pointer and moves to the next state.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:029A
name: advance_record_state_machine
description: Adds the input amount to a field and dispatches on a state byte. In state four it returns unless a flag is set, in state one it makes a call, and in state six it loads the next data pointer and moves to the next state.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:02DC
name: settle_record_state_four
description: Sets a record's state to four, stores a start value, calls another routine and then advances a position field, checking flag bits to decide whether the record is finished.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:02F0
name: advance_record_state_three
description: Handles the three state of a record by loading the next data pointer, moving the record to state two and making a call. Otherwise it compares and clips the position fields.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:030E
name: set_state_two_and_clip
description: Sets a record's state to two, stores a start value and a time, calls another routine, then clamps an accumulated word into a fixed range while stepping its position.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0374
name: advance_voice_state_four
description: Sets a voice's state to four, stores the current position and calls another routine. It then advances a counter and clears a flag bit when the counter reaches its threshold.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0380
name: start_voice_at_record
description: Points a voice at the input record's data, stores an initial position and calls another routine, then steps the voice timer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:03AA
name: step_voice_level_and_timer
description: Adds a step to the voice's level, clamping the result to a fixed range, subtracts the input from a position and steps the voice timer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:03C4
name: step_voice_position_only
description: Clears a voice's level field, subtracts the input from its position and steps the voice timer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:03FC
name: start_voice_playback
description: Sets flag bits on a voice, builds a bit mask from a shift count and stores a default period of one thousand when none is given. It then calls another routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:043E
name: reset_voice_period_defaults
description: Stores a default period of one thousand and a zero word into a voice structure, then calls a routine taken from a table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0454
name: clear_voice_active_flags
description: Calls another routine four times, then clears the active bit in every voice record of a fixed-size table and in the shared active flag.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0492
name: set_voice_mask_and_period
description: Sets a power-of-two bit mask for a voice from a register value and sets its flag byte. It calls another routine and, when the voice's level is low, writes a fixed value to that voice's hardware audio register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:04D6
name: release_voice_and_reset
description: Releases a voice by decrementing a shared active count unless the voice is in its last slot. It clears the voice's fields and flags, sets its bit mask, calls another routine and writes a fixed value to that voice's hardware audio register when its level is low.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:050A
name: init_voice_defaults_and_flags
description: Initialises several fields of a voice record to fixed values, then sets or clears flag bits according to the input bit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0550
name: apply_voice_effect_command
description: Applies one effect command byte to a voice record. A command of five sets a base field from a byte, the percent sign merges a low byte into it, and a command of six sets a clamped volume and a derived level when the voice is idle.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0568
name: apply_voice_effect_subset
description: Handles the percent-sign effect command for a voice record by merging a low byte into a base field and clearing the related flag bits.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0582
name: apply_voice_volume_effect
description: Handles the six effect command for a voice record, setting a clamped volume and a derived level when the voice is idle. A seven command sets a level field from a byte with an increment.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:05C6
name: apply_voice_flag_effects
description: Handles the seven effect command by setting a level field from a byte with an increment. The ten command sets or clears a flag bit, and the at-sign command sets a flag bit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:05DC
name: apply_voice_flag_effects
description: Handles the ten effect command by setting or clearing a flag bit, and the at-sign command by clearing a bit in matching voice records when its flag is clear.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0600
name: set_voice_active_flag
description: Sets bit zero of a voice's flag byte and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:060A
name: handle_at_command_voice_state
description: Handles the at-sign command for a voice. When the input byte's bit six is clear it clears a flag bit and moves any matching voice records to state three, otherwise it sets the flag bit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0622
name: clear_voice_matches_state_three
description: Clears a flag bit in a voice record, then moves any matching voice records in a fixed-size table to state three when their flag bit is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:064E
name: apply_voice_letter_commands
description: Handles letter-coded command bytes for a voice. The letter A sets or clears a flag bit and a field, the letters d and e store input bytes into two fields, and other letters are passed on to further routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0666
name: clear_voice_flag_and_reset
description: Clears bit two of a voice's flag byte and sets a field to its maximum value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0676
name: dispatch_voice_command_chain
description: Checks the command byte against a set of letters and symbols. Matching commands store an input byte in a field, set or clear a flag bit, or call another routine, and unmatched commands are passed on.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:068C
name: forward_voice_command_call
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns, passing a voice command down the chain.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0698

description: Checks the command byte against a set of letters and symbols. Matching commands store an input byte in a field, set or clear a flag bit, or call another routine, and unmatched commands are passed on.

name: dispatch_voice_command_chain
description: Checks the command byte against a set of letters and symbols. Matching commands store an input byte in a field, set or clear a flag bit, or call another routine, and unmatched commands are passed on.

name: dispatch_voice_command_chain
description: Checks the command byte against a set of letters and symbols. Matching commands store an input byte in a field, set or clear a flag bit, or call another routine, and unmatched commands are passed on.

name: dispatch_voice_command_chain
description: Checks the command byte against a set of letters and symbols. Matching commands store an input byte in a field, set or clear a flag bit, or call another routine, and unmatched commands are passed on.

name: dispatch_voice_command_chain
description: Checks the command byte against a set of letters and symbols. Matching commands store an input byte in a field, set or clear a flag bit, or call another routine, and unmatched commands are passed on.

name: dispatch_voice_command_chain
description: Checks the command byte against a set of letters and symbols. Matching commands store an input byte in a field, set or clear a flag bit, or call another routine, and unmatched commands are passed on.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:06F0
name: dispatch_voice_command_chain
description: Checks the command byte against a set of letters and symbols. Matching commands store an input byte in a field, set or clear a flag bit, or call another routine, and unmatched commands are passed on.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:06FC
name: assemble_value_and_scale_diff
description: Assembles a 16-bit value from two bytes and stores it in a voice field. It then computes a scaled difference from that value into a second field and sets the high bit of the flag byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0728
name: signed_32bit_division
description: Divides two 32-bit values by calling an unsigned divide routine, and negates the quotient when the two operands have different signs.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:074E
name: call_and_return_register
description: Calls another routine and returns the register value that routine leaves behind.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0758
name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls another routine and returns without further work of its own.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0760
name: perform_32bit_division
description: Computes the quotient and remainder of a 32-bit division. A bit-shifting loop handles divisors above sixteen bits and a simpler path handles smaller ones, and the result is returned as a quotient and remainder pair.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:07D4
name: interpolate_table_pair_value
description: Looks up two neighbouring entries of a value table using the high byte of the input, then interpolates between them by the low byte, rounding to a fixed-point result.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0A26
name: allocate_and_register_audio_server
description: Allocates a block for the sound driver through the exec library, carves it into per-channel records at fixed offsets and registers an interrupt server for the audio interrupt. It returns one if the allocation fails.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0B66
name: release_audio_server_and_memory
description: Removes the audio interrupt server and frees the sound driver's memory block through the exec library, clearing the stored pointers.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0BCE
name: init_audio_device
description: Sets up the sound channel table and opens the audio device through the exec library, copying prepared data into place and handling the device's message replies.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0D48
name: close_audio_device
description: Stops the sound channels in use, clears their flags and closes the audio device through the exec library.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0DB6
name: queue_sound_request
description: Queues or starts a sound request for a channel that is not already active, choosing a free channel from a fixed-size table when needed.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0E50
name: fill_sound_request_record
description: Fills a sound request record with a sample pointer, a length, a volume-like value and a fixed mode value, reusing the record from a free list.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0E7C
name: handle_audio_reply_message
description: Receives a reply message from the audio device through the exec library, updates the channel record's state and volume, and returns the message.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:0F50
name: advance_audio_channel_after_reply
description: Processes a finished audio request by advancing the channel's counter. When the channel is in a looping state it resets its position and sends a new request.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1046
name: clear_sound_request_record
description: Clears the fields of a sound request record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:105A
name: match_channel_command_state
description: Looks up the channel record for the current index and, when its state byte matches the command byte from the input, sets the channel's flag bit or moves it to state three.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1094
name: match_voice_command_byte
description: Compares the input byte with a voice's stored command byte and, on a match, either moves the voice to state three or sets its flag bit, depending on a record flag.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:10AA
name: set_voice_retrigger_flag
description: Sets bit two of a voice's flag byte and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:10B4
name: update_matching_voice_states
description: For each of four voice records that matches the input record, sets its state to three or sets bit two of its flag byte, depending on a record flag.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:10D6
name: flag_matching_records_in_list
description: Walks a list of records, setting the state of each matching record to three and setting a flag bit in its entry when the record's flag is set, until the counter runs out.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:10E6
name: notify_matching_voice_records
description: For each voice record in a table of four that matches the input record, calls another routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1112
name: reset_all_voice_records
description: Calls another routine for each active voice record in a table of four, then clears a flag bit and sets a field to its maximum value in each of sixteen channel records.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1158
name: store_table_entry_pointer
description: Stores the address of a shared table entry, selected by masking the input value and multiplying by a fixed stride, into a pointer supplied in a register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1174
name: store_word_and_call_result
description: Stores an input word in a shared global, calls another routine and stores its result in a second global.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:11C4
name: update_fire_button_flag
description: Calls a routine that reads a controller-port register, then sets bit one of a shared flag byte when the reading is zero and clears it otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:11E0
name: check_fire_flag_clear
description: Returns one when bit one of a shared flag byte is clear, and zero otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:11F4
name: latch_and_flag_channel_records
description: When a shared value is nonzero, it stores that value, sets a high bit in each non-empty channel record and clears the shared value. Then it calls other routines to continue the update.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:12A4
name: tick_channel_countdowns
description: Walks channel countdown records, subtracting a step from each counter. When a counter reaches zero or passes it, the record is cleared and its data is processed through other routines until it is exhausted.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1370
name: process_channel_event_bytes
description: Reads event bytes from a channel's sequence data and dispatches each by value. A special value triggers a timing check that sets the channel's period fields, and other values are passed to further routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1396
name: resume_channel_event_sequence
description: Continues a channel's event sequence after a timing check, setting the channel's period fields and advancing the sequence pointer while time remains.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:13C0
name: handle_channel_end_marker
description: Handles the end-marker event for a channel sequence. When the channel's loop flag is set it rewinds the sequence pointer to its start, otherwise it clears the flag, then stores the pointer and continues with another routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:13E0
name: advance_channel_timing
description: Clears a channel's flag bit, stores its sequence pointer and, when the channel's time value is nonzero, adds the step to the running timer. It then calls other routines depending on whether the timer has passed its target.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:13EA
name: dispatch_channel_event_codes
description: Dispatches channel event codes by value. Some codes call a single routine, and the minus-ninety-six code reads sequence fields and sets a sample state when the channel is ready.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1424
name: dispatch_channel_event_subset
description: Dispatches the remaining channel event codes. The minus-eighty and minus-sixty-four codes each call a routine, and the minus-ninety-six code reads sequence fields to set a sample state.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1452
name: dispatch_channel_event_tail
description: Handles the minus-sixty-four and minus-ninety-six channel event codes. The second reads sequence fields to set a sample state.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:147A
name: signal_channel_event_task
description: Handles the minus-ninety-six channel event by setting a sample state from sequence fields and, for one state, signals a task through the exec library.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:14B0
name: push_channel_loop_entry
description: Handles event code two by pushing the current sequence pointer and a repeat count onto a small per-channel loop stack of up to four entries. Event code three pops an entry when the stack is not empty.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:14E0
name: repeat_channel_loop_entry
description: Handles event code three by decrementing the top loop counter and, while it stays nonzero, jumping the sequence pointer back to the saved position.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1514
name: read_channel_sequence_stream
description: Stores a loop-stack level from the input and runs a sequence-reading loop that fetches each command from the channel's data, comparing the running time with each event's duration.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:151C
name: fetch_next_sequence_event
description: Reads the next event from a channel's data, adds its duration to the running time and leaves the loop when the time has run out.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1522
name: finish_channel_sequence_step
description: Stores the sequence pointer and, when the channel's time value is nonzero, advances the running timer and calls other routines depending on whether the target has been passed.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:154E
name: refresh_channel_flags_from_records
description: Calls routines to refresh a channel's state and sets bit two of its flag byte. It then loops over three voice records, updating that flag from their state and calling a fixed-point multiply routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:158A
name: merge_voice_flags_into_channel
description: Walks a block of records, calling a routine for those with a flag set, then merges one channel flag byte into another and returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:15BC
name: advance_table_loop_counter
description: Decrements a loop counter and repeatedly advances through a shared table, skipping entries that match a marker with a zero flag. It reloads the traversal pointer from a saved entry until the counter is exhausted.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1638
name: reset_channel_state_globals
description: Resets the shared channel state when a check returns zero: it clears flag bits, fills a mask with ones, zeroes the counters and points the table traversal at its first entry.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:16DC
name: set_status_bit_when_nonzero
description: Calls another routine and sets bit four of a shared flag byte when its result is not zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:16EC
name: clear_flag_and_notify_records
description: Clears bit zero of a shared flag byte, then calls another routine for each of three non-empty records.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1720
name: set_global_active_flag
description: Sets bit zero of a shared flag byte and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:17EE
name: request_service_with_buffer
description: Sends a service request with code two through the exec library's signal call, then waits until the handler clears the request and returns the request buffer pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1842
name: request_service_with_argument
description: Sends a service request with code three and an argument through the exec library's signal call, then waits until the handler clears the request.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:186E
name: poll_audio_message_port
description: When the channel's flag bit is set, fetches a message from a port through the exec library, fills in its fields for the channel and sends it on, returning the reply status.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:18CC
name: clear_bit_and_reset_fields
description: Clears bit three of a channel flag byte, zeroes a field and a word, and calls another routine when two adjacent bytes differ.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1902
name: request_service_and_return_argument
description: Sends service request code four with an argument through the exec library's signal call, waits until the handler clears it, then returns the argument.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1934
name: handle_pending_service_request
description: Takes a pending service request and clears it. For request code one it loads channel fields from the request record and calls other routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:19EA
name: handle_channel_request_message
description: Handles service request code two. When a message is available it gets one from a port through the exec library, sets its fields from the channel record and sends it.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:8:1B64
name: reply_channel_message
description: Sends a reply for a channel's message through the exec library, clears bit three of its flag byte and either marks the channel for state two or passes a message back.
